title: THE GIRL
IN THE
TOWER

hook.say: A princess was locked in this tower to save her life. It didn't work.

outro.say: Would you spend a night in the Maiden's Tower? Comment below!

items.say: This is Kiz Koo-leh-see, the Maiden's Tower, on a tiny island in the middle of Istanbul's Bosphorus.
items.cap: This is Kız Kulesi, the Maiden's Tower, on a tiny island in the middle of Istanbul's Bosphorus.

items.say: Legend says a fortune teller warned an emperor: your daughter will die from a snake bite, on her eighteenth birthday.
So he built her a tower out at sea, where no snake could ever reach her.
On her birthday, he brought a basket of fruit to celebrate. Hidden inside, was a snake.
The real story is even older. About 2400 years ago, the Athenians used this rock to tax ships from the Black Sea.
items.cap: The real story is even older. About 2,400 years ago, the Athenians used this rock to tax ships from the Black Sea.

items.say: In eleven-ten, a Byzantine emperor built a wooden tower here, and stretched an iron chain across the water.
items.cap: In 1110, a Byzantine emperor built a wooden tower here, and stretched an iron chain across the water.

items.say: The Ottomans rebuilt it in stone, and turned it into a lighthouse.
Today the ferries still pass, the seagulls still circle, and every evening, people gather on the shore to watch the sunset behind it.
